notes: Uniform sampling without replacement over all eligible non-overlapping 12.8kb tiles; no model-output selection.
Each window has equal weight: mean of region token counts divided by that window's final token count.
Original shares use the same windows; pooled token shares and sample standard deviations are diagnostic only.
Raw DNA only, model.eval(), no annotation or routing_step input; independent training runs remain separate.
Parent coordinates and sequence offsets are recorded separately because stored sequences may be reverse-complemented.
Dataset train is a storage-container name: Human uses held-out chromosomes; Mouse is unseen during model training.
